multi_course_analysis.why_id_series_is_not_a_nine_split: The two green batches interleave geographically (batch1 extent lat 43.42559..43.43450 / lon -79.87562..-79.86801; batch2 extent lat 43.42720..43.43169 / lon -79.87174..-79.86460 sits INSIDE batch1). They are consecutive editing sessions, not front/back nine. Hole numbering CANNOT be recovered from OSM - a mapper must survey it.

actual_parser_output.name: Imported Course
warnings: Couldn't find a course boundary feature - using a generic name and no location.
No golf=hole centerlines with a usable ref number were found - falling back to 18 holes, par 4, with no shape data.
Holes 1..18 have no OSM centerline - created as empty placeholders (par defaulted to 4).
actual_parser_output.explanation: With holeLineByNumber empty, holeLineList is empty, so nearestHoleNumber()/nearestHoleByCenterlineHalf() both return null and every golf polygon hits `if (!nearest) continue;`. All 128 importable polygons (18 greens, 27 fairways, 42 tees, 33 bunkers, 8 water hazards) are silently dropped. The import produces an empty 18-hole shell.
